mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vm_emergency_event_info (event_code, event_name, event_grade_dict, event_time, event_type_large_category, event_type_middle_category, event_type_small_category, province_code, city_code, country_code, specific_location, longitude, latitude, event_describe, remark, tenant_id, industry_code, create_time, creator, delete_flag, status) VALUES (#{eventCode}, #{eventName}, #{eventGradeDict}, #{eventTime}, #{eventTypeLargeCategory}, #{eventTypeMiddleCategory}, #{eventTypeSmallCategory}, #{provinceCode}, #{cityCode}, #{countryCode}, #{specificLocation}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{eventDescribe}, #{remark}, #{tenantId}, #{industryCode}, now(), #{creator}, 0, #{status})
mapper.update:
UPDATE vm_emergency_event_info
event_name = #{eventName},
event_grade_dict = #{eventGradeDict},
event_time = #{eventTime},
event_type_large_category = #{eventTypeLargeCategory}, event_type_middle_category = #{eventTypeMiddleCategory}, event_type_small_category = #{eventTypeSmallCategory},
province_code = #{provinceCode},
city_code = #{cityCode},
country_code = #{countryCode},
specific_location = #{specificLocation},
longitude = #{longitude},
latitude = #{latitude},
event_describe = #{eventDescribe},
remark = #{remark},
tenant_id = #{tenantId},
industry_code = #{industryCode},
update_time = now(),
modifier = #{modifier},
delete_flag = #{deleteFlag},
status = #{status},
WHERE 1 = 1
AND event_code = #{eventCode}
mapper.select: SELECT event.id, event.event_code, event.event_name, event.event_grade_dict, event.event_time, event.event_type_large_category, event.event_type_middle_category, event.event_type_small_category, event.province_code, event.city_code, event.country_code, a1.AREA_NAME province, a2.AREA_NAME city, a3.AREA_NAME country, event.specific_location, event.longitude, event.latitude, event.event_describe, event.remark, event.tenant_id, event.industry_code, event.app_ver_code, event.create_time, event.creator, event.update_time, event.modifier, event.delete_flag, event.status FROM vm_emergency_event_info event LEFT JOIN sys_area a1 ON a1.AREA_CODE = event.province_code LEFT JOIN sys_area a2 ON a2.AREA_CODE = event.city_code LEFT JOIN sys_area a3 ON a3.AREA_CODE = event.country_code WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND industry_code = #{industryCode} AND event_code = #{eventCode}
